notes: CASEY VOEKS'S SECOND 2016 FILING — same filer and same construction as 17bb61d5, and the pair together shows the county form and the filer's own ledger are STOCKED AND FILLED INDEPENDENTLY of each other. Cover blank: 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', 'Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13', HEART of UTAH letterhead, inner sheets strap-lined '2016 County Commission & Local School Board Candidate', and the SCHEDULE B column heading is 'Name of Contributor' — Schedule A's heading reused over the vendor column, the 2012-era defect, exactly as on his June filing and UNLIKE Bowen ('Expenditure') and Ivie ('Name/Nature of Expenditure') in the same seat and cycle. 6 pages, each classified by its own printed header: p1 cover (30 Days after the Primary Election, signed July 8 2016, amendment ticked 'No'; clerk's received stamp reads AUG 17), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 the county's SCHEDULE A grid, p4 the filer's own ledger, p5 the county's SCHEDULE B grid, p6 the filer's own ledger. ⚠ THE POINTER IS TYPED THIS TIME AND THE FOLIATION IS COMPLETE. On p3 and p5 the county grids are empty except for a single TYPED line on the first ruled row — 'See next page (page 4 of 6) for Schedule A report on Itemized Contributions Received.' and 'See next page (page 6 of 6) for Schedule B report on Itemized Expenditures Made.' — where his June filing carried the same pointer HANDWRITTEN across two rows. Both are ANNOTATIONS, not entries: zero rows, and every amount cell and both printed footers on those two pages are blank. The Page __ of __ / Last Name / Date of Report block is TYPED and filled on pp2/3/5 (2, 3, 5 of 6) and hand-numbered on the ledger sheets (4 of 6, 6 of 6) — a complete, cover-counting foliation, in contrast to Bowen's and Ivie's wholly blank blocks. This is the §A2/§E5 case — the county's FORM is what is missing, not the filer's entries — so BOTH sides are `transcribed` and NEITHER is `no-schedule-page`. The ledger's columns are Date / Name of Contributor / Address / Amount on Schedule A and Date / VENDOR / Address / Amount on Schedule B. Field-shift screen run on both sides: every column's content matches its heading on all 39 rows, no inversion. PAGE-FACE NAME 'Casey Voeks' (Office Seeking 'County Commission Seat C', party Republican, residence Eagle Mountain UT), typed on the cover and signed 'CASEY VOEKS'; index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it. Note this cover TYPES the seat as 'County Commission Seat C' where his June cover has it handwritten as 'COUNTY COMMISSION C' — same seat, two renderings by one filer. PRIVACY: not a redacted file; every donor and vendor street line is published in the clear. Reduced to city/state at read time for contributions and dropped entirely for expenditures. OTHER PROPERTIES: no in-kind rows, no negative amounts, no nil marks, no ditto marks, no continuation lines, no voided rows, no banner lines; the one-band-past control rendered an EMPTY cell on both ledger sheets, so none of the five row-index traps of addendum F1 occurs here. One date cell holds a RANGE (Schedule B row 15). The filer reports a $0.00 closing balance funded by a 106.57 self-contribution on the last day of the period.
